request.style: English, atmospheric worship, female lead vocal with male harmony, ambient electric guitar swells, piano, synth pads, slow-building drums, luminous, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Up the mountain, six days later
Peter, James and John
Far above the noisy valley
Where the light was coming on

[Chorus]
His face shone like the sun
And his clothes became white as the light
This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased
Listen to him

[Verse]
Moses and Elijah appeared
Talking with him there
Lord, it is good for us to be here
Peter spoke into the air

[Chorus]
His face shone like the sun
And his clothes became white as the light
This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased
Listen to him

[Bridge]
A bright cloud overshadowed them
They fell face down, terrified
But Jesus came and touched them
Get up, do not be afraid
And they saw no one but Jesus alone

[Outro]
Listen to him
Listen to him
